items.headline: 葛蘭姆驟逝，享年71歲
items.context: 美國共和黨參議員林賽·葛蘭姆（Lindsey Graham）因「突發且短暫的疾病」過世，享年 71 歲。他是川普的親密盟友，川普稱他是「真正的美國愛國者」，並表示將非常想念他。南卡羅來納州的參議員席次接下來由誰遞補，川普已在考慮人選。

items.headline: 曼谷酒吧大火27死
items.context: 泰國曼谷一間酒吧半夜爆發大火，目前已知至少 27 人死亡。消防隊在午夜過後接獲通報趕抵現場，發現顧客從烈焰吞噬的正門逃出。
items.thread_text:
泰國曼谷一間酒吧半夜爆發大火，目前已知至少 27 人死亡。消防隊在午夜過後接獲通報趕抵現場，發現顧客從烈焰吞噬的正門逃出，網路流傳的畫面可見火勢猛烈、濃煙從門口竄出。

本則整理自 NPR 與 BBC 於 2026 年 7 月 13 日發佈的報導。
items.threads_text:

items.headline: 美伊互襲，荷莫茲告急
items.context: 美軍與伊朗持續互相攻擊，美方稱一夜之間擊中伊朗境內 140 個目標，伊朗則向約旦與波斯灣多國發動反擊。伊朗宣稱荷莫茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）已經關閉，但美方堅持海峽仍然開放。
items.thread_text:
美伊衝突持續升高。美軍稱一夜之間擊中伊朗境內 140 個軍事目標，伊朗隨即向約旦與波斯灣多個國家發動大規模反擊。伊朗官方宣稱荷莫茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）已經關閉，但美方堅持海峽仍然開放，雙方說法互相矛盾。

本則整理自 Reuters、NPR 與 BBC 於 2026 年 7 月 12 日發佈的報導。
items.threads_text:
波斯灣的局勢又緊張了一層。美軍一夜之間對伊朗境內 140 個軍事目標發動攻擊，伊朗隨即擴大反擊範圍，向約旦與波斯灣多個國家發射飛彈。最關鍵的分歧在荷莫茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）——這裡是全球石油運輸的咽喉要道。伊朗官方宣稱海峽已經關閉，但美方堅持航道仍然開放。兩邊各說各話，情勢還在演變中。

本則整理自 Reuters、NPR 與 BBC 於 2026 年 7 月 12 日發佈的報導。

items.headline: 卡達前埃米爾逝世
items.context: 卡達前埃米爾哈瑪德·本·哈里發·阿勒薩尼（Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani）逝世，享年 74 歲。他在 1996 年發動不流血政變推翻父親奪權，之後將卡達打造成天然氣蘊藏豐富的區域強權。
items.thread_text:
卡達前埃米爾哈瑪德·本·哈里發·阿勒薩尼（Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani）逝世，享年 74 歲。他在 1996 年發動不流血政變推翻父親奪權，之後把卡達打造成天然氣蘊藏豐富的區域強權。前英國駐卡達大使回憶他為人謙遜又幽默。

本則整理自 Reuters、Al Jazeera 與 BBC 於 2026 年 7 月 12 日發佈的報導。
items.threads_text:
卡達的一段歷史落幕了。前埃米爾哈瑪德·本·哈里發·阿勒薩尼（Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani）過世，享年 74 歲。他在 1996 年發動不流血政變，從父親手中接下權力，此後三十年把這個波斯灣小國打造成天然氣蘊藏豐富的區域強權，也讓卡達在中東外交舞台上取得舉足輕重的地位。前英國駐卡達大使回憶他為人謙遜又幽默，是難得能與外界輕鬆相處的君主。

本則整理自 Reuters、Al Jazeera 與 BBC 於 2026 年 7 月 12 日發佈的報導。

As her debut is published, she talks about single life, oversharing and why she still believes she’ll find love There is a scene in Annie Lord’s novel that will be instantly familiar to any young person who has spent time at a pub or nightclub recently. sources.summary: Braboeuf Manor, Guildford Elegantly stitching the plays into two parts of the same continuing story, Tom Littler’s sunny al fresco productions play every possible tragicomic note Two Shakespearean comedies dated to the last decade of the 16th century each seem to lack something. Love’s Labour’s Lost (c 1595) feels in need of a sequel, ending abruptly, with the usual climactic marriages suddenly deferred to the future. Much Ado About Nothing (c 1598) could use a prequel: there is clearly a tantalising backstory to the harsh sparring between Beatrice and Benedick. By double-billing the plays, director Tom Littler explores the scholarly hypothesis (well advanced by HR Woudhuysen) that they may be, in Hollywood terms, parts 1 and 2. Some believe that a Shakespeare play, Love’s Labour’s Won, listed in documents but now missing, may have been Much Ado, which contains a possible Shakespeare in-joke about things seeming clearer “when you have seen the sequel.” Continue reading...

But there is some fun, too, in this heart-filled musical adaptation of the cartoonist’s illustrated memoir. First seen in the UK in 2018 and now revived by director Sarah Frankcom in a fluid in-the-round staging, it brings a light touch to a story freighted with emotion. Published in 2006, the graphic novel describes the author’s sexual awakening – she kissed a girl and she liked it – one that coincided with the discovery of her father’s clandestine gay life. In the musical adaptation by Lisa Kron (book and lyrics) and Jeanine Tesori (music), it becomes a layered reckoning of past and present, as the 43-year-old Bechdel (Jodie McNee) reflects on her student self (Alice Audrey O’Hanlon) reflecting on her childhood self (Felicity Moore at my performance). sources.summary: Yankee Stadium, New York City The rapper celebrates 30 years of his classic debut album Reasonable Doubt with eye-popping visuals and special guests in a love letter to hip-hop culture The beauty of watching Jay-Z live is more than just watching him calmly spit bars that effortlessly prove why his career has been this long and brilliant; it’s also the complex but lovely feeling of watching an audience (and the artist himself) relive the past. It’s almost unfathomable that 30 years ago, Jay-Z was starting out as a relatively unknown rapper from Brooklyn chronicling his life as a hustler. Quite possibly the greatest pure MC of all-time – encompassing flow, patience, humor, live ability and his taste as an auteur – Jay built a career on restrained tales of wide-eyed dreams and braggadocious stanzas about financial gain. His 1996 debut album, Reasonable Doubt, was the start of that career, and on Friday night, I’m at New York City’s Yankee Stadium as Jay-Z performs the album’s tracks in order, front to back, making it impossible to forget its legacy in a visually stunning show that splits the difference between close connection and grand spectacle. At times, with a wide, movie-like screen backing Jay that shows funerals of presidents, footage of Mike Tyson , or his wife, Beyoncé, cutting his hair at the ballpark, the show feels influenced by previous tours like Watch the Throne mixed with the street romance of the 2002 movie Paid in Full. Yet the care and attention to detail ensures that the 50,000-capacity venue feels intimate, for the folks who heard the album and felt seen through its songs of regret and paranoia. items.headline: 量子AI助攻新藥研發
items.context: 一群科學家自己湊資金、擠出時間，利用量子運算輔助設計新型胜肽（peptide），希望加速開發能用於罕見疾病與弱勢族群的藥物。
items.thread_text:
一群科學家把這當成「副業」在做：自己湊資金、擠出下班時間，嘗試用量子運算輔助設計新型胜肽（peptide）。目標很明確——加速開發能用於罕見疾病、也能造福弱勢族群的藥物。

本則來自 Wired，2026 年 7 月 12 日發佈的報導。
items.threads_text:

items.headline: AI迴圈研究法出爐
items.context: 一篇教學介紹「迴圈工程」（loop engineering），說明如何運用 Andrej Karpathy 的 autoresearch 專案與 Bilevel Autoresearch 論文，讓 AI 代理人（agent）自動跑完整套機器學習研究流程，取代過去一問一答式的使用方式。
items.thread_text:
AI 使用方式正在變。這篇教學介紹「迴圈工程」（loop engineering），說的是別再一問一答地跟 AI 對話，而是讓它自己跑一整個迴圈。教學引用 Andrej Karpathy 的 autoresearch 專案，以及 Bilevel Autoresearch 論文，示範怎麼讓 AI 代理人（agent）自動化完成整套機器學習研究流程。

本則來自 MarkTechPost，2026 年 7 月 13 日發佈的報導。

items.headline: 穆拉蒂談人本AI理念
items.context: 前 OpenAI 技術長米拉·穆拉蒂（Mira Murati）創辦的 Thinking Machines Lab 發表文章，主張讓使用者能保留、客製化自己訓練出的 AI 模型權重，而非全部鎖在大型企業手中。
items.thread_text:
前 OpenAI 技術長米拉·穆拉蒂（Mira Murati）創辦的新公司 Thinking Machines Lab，發表了一篇文章談他們對 AI 的理念，題目是「值得打造的未來，是屬於人的」。核心主張是：使用者應該能保留、客製化自己訓練出的模型權重，而不是全部被鎖在少數大型企業手中。這個理念也對應到他們產品 Tinker 的 LoRA 微調功能，讓使用者自己訓練、保有模型。

本則來自 MarkTechPost，2026 年 7 月 12 日發佈的報導。
items.threads_text:

sources.summary: These financiers want to remodel the UK into a form that suits them – one that could threaten to erode the barriers between crime and business This coming Tuesday, the government’s representation of the people bill comes back to the House of Commons for its third reading. It bundles up a multitude of measures, including an extension of the franchise to 16- and 17-year-olds and welcome changes to voter registration. But thanks to the continuing furore around Nigel Farage and his extremely wealthy friends – such as the Thailand-based crypto-investor Christopher Harborne , who gave Farage a £5m “lottery win” personal gift and has donated in excess of £22m to Reform UK – the aspects of the legislation that have suddenly become its headline measures are focused on big-money donations. The government has already implemented a moratorium – but only a moratorium – on political donations in cryptocurrencies , the encrypted digital assets that, to quote the Electoral Commission , “present particular challenges and risks in meeting electoral law requirements in identifying donors and ensuring they are permissible”. There is a new annual £100,000 limit on donations from British citizens living abroad. Other legislative moves will now take the form of amendments to the bill: they include new checks on whether companies making donations are above board by measuring their profit as well as their revenues, and a requirement for parliamentary candidates to declare any donation above £2,230 (although “personal gifts” will continue to be exempt). items.headline: 中聯油品擴大下架退換
items.context: 行政院擴大預防性下架中聯油脂 4 到 6 月生產的油品後，進一步公布退換貨機制：消費者可持購買證明或空桶，向泰山、福壽、福懋三家主要供應商辦理退貨，也能持消費紀錄到超商、超市退換，部分通路須回原購買店家辦理。
items.thread_text:
行政院擴大預防性下架中聯油脂 4 到 6 月生產的油品後，進一步公布退換貨機制。消費者可以持購買證明或商品空桶，直接向泰山、福壽、福懋三家主要供應商辦理退貨；也可以持消費紀錄前往超商、超市等通路退換，不過部分通路須回原購買店家辦理。

本則來自 公視，2026 年 7 月 12 日發佈的報導。
items.threads_text:
買過中聯油脂油品的人，退換貨管道有譜了。行政院日前已經擴大預防性下架中聯油脂 4 到 6 月生產的油品，現在進一步公布了退換機制：消費者可以持購買證明或商品空桶，直接向泰山、福壽、福懋三家主要供應商辦理退貨。也可以持消費紀錄前往超商、超市等通路退換，不過要留意，部分通路須回原本購買的店家辦理，不能隨便找一家分店退。

本則來自 公視，2026 年 7 月 12 日發佈的報導。
